title: JRE 2379 - Matthew McConaughey
guestBio: Matthew McConaughey is an Academy Award–winning actor and #1 New York Times bestselling author. His new book, "Poems & Prayers,” comes out September 16. His latest film, "The Lost Bus," will open in select theaters in Los Angeles, New York, and London on September 19 and premiere globally on October 3 on Apple TV+. Matthew is a professor of practice at the University of Texas at Austin, co-owner of Pantalones tequila, co-owner of the Austin FC soccer club, and co-founder of the just keep livin' Foundation, which supports youth through programs in health, education, and active living.

recap:
Joe welcomes Matthew McConaughey to JRE 2379 to talk about his latest creative endeavors and life philosophy. McConaughey has been busy across multiple fronts: he's got a new poetry and prayers book dropping September 16, a film called 'The Lost Bus' hitting select theaters September 19 before going global on Apple TV+ October 3, and he's maintaining his gig as a professor of practice at the University of Texas at Austin where he teaches and mentors students.

Beyond the entertainment world, McConaughey discusses his business interests including his ownership stake in Pantalones tequila and his role as co-owner of Austin FC soccer club. The conversation naturally flows into deeper territory as McConaughey talks about his approach to life and decision-making. He emphasizes the importance of staying true to yourself and pursuing work that feels meaningful rather than just chasing the biggest paycheck or most prestigious role.

McConaughey opens up about how his career choices have evolved over time, moving toward projects and ventures that align with his values. He talks about the responsibility of using his platform and influence for something greater than himself. The discussion touches on his 'just keep livin' philosophy and how that mindset has guided him through various challenges and opportunities throughout his career and personal life.

The conversation also digs into his creative process for both writing and acting, exploring how he approaches character development and what drives him to choose certain projects. McConaughey reflects on lessons learned throughout his journey in Hollywood and how those experiences inform his work as an educator at UT Austin. It's classic McConaughey conversation material: ambitious, thoughtful, and grounded in practical life philosophy.
